title: Kingdomity's Vanilla+
body:
# Information:
All the Mods I use when recording my videos. This gives Minecraft a whole new look and keeps the Vanilla feel. You can download and try this for yourself. I made this modpack for anyone wondering what mods I use.

# Performance:
Using Sodium, Lithium, and ImmediatelyFast your game will have improved frame rates, less lag, and optimizes chunk loading.
